caution.body: Prices can move, and trading in a stock can be limited. An order may fill at a different price than you expected, only in part, or not at all.

results.glanceTitle: All Order Types at a Glance

limit.name: Limit Order
limit.does: You choose the price. A buy fills at your price or lower. A sell fills at your price or higher.
know: It may not fill if the market never reaches your price.
Only part of your order may fill at your price.
limit.short: Trade only at your price or better
limit.best: When the price matters more than speed

market.name: Market at Best
market.does: Sends your order to trade now at the best price available in the market.
know: The price you get can differ from the last price you saw, especially in shares that trade little.
Check Market Depth first to see the orders waiting at each price.
market.short: Trade now at the best available price
market.best: When getting the trade done matters more than the exact price

stoploss.name: Stop Loss
stoploss.does: A sell instruction that is triggered if the price falls to the level you choose, to limit a loss.
know: It is not a guarantee. The price can fall past your level, and the order may fill lower, or not at all.
Choose the level before you buy, not after the price starts falling.
stoploss.short: Sell if the price falls to your level
stoploss.best: Limiting a loss on shares you hold

takeprofit.name: Take Profit
takeprofit.does: A sell instruction that is triggered if the price rises to the level you choose, to take a gain.
know: The price may never reach your level.
Once sold, you no longer gain if the price keeps rising.
takeprofit.short: Sell if the price rises to your target
takeprofit.best: Taking a gain at a price you picked in advance

premarket.name: Pre-Market Order
premarket.does: An order you place before the market opens, so it is ready when trading starts.
know: The price at the open can differ from yesterday’s close.
Like any order, it may not fill if the price does not reach your level.
premarket.best: Being ready at the start of the day

gtd.name: Good Till Date
gtd.does: Keeps an order active until the date you choose, instead of only for today.
know: Check the order from time to time. Cancel it if you change your mind.
The price you set may be far from the market by the time the date arrives.
gtd.short: Keep an order active until a date
gtd.best: Orders you do not want to re-enter every day

how.title: How to Choose

items.title: Price or Speed?
items.body: If the exact price matters, use a Limit order. If getting the trade done now matters more, use Market at Best.

items.title: Protect or Take a Gain?
items.body: To plan a sale in advance, Stop Loss reacts to a fall and Take Profit reacts to a rise. Both are instructions you set before the price moves.

items.title: Today or Later?
items.body: Orders last for the day unless you add Good Till Date. Pre-Market lets you place an order before the market opens.

how.example: Example: you own a share bought at ৳100 and want to limit the loss. You choose Stop Loss and set the level at ৳95, so a sell instruction is triggered if the price falls to that level.

items.q: What is the difference between a Limit order and Market at Best?
items.a: A Limit order fixes your price but may not fill. Market at Best trades now at the best available price, but the price can differ from the one you saw.

items.q: What is a Stop Loss order?
items.a: A Stop Loss is a sell instruction that is triggered if the price falls to the level you choose, to limit a loss. It is not a guarantee, because the price can fall past your level.

items.q: What is a Take Profit order?
items.a: A Take Profit is a sell instruction that is triggered if the price rises to the level you choose, so you can take a gain without watching the screen.

items.q: What does Good Till Date mean?
items.a: It keeps an order active until the date you choose instead of only for today. You can still modify or cancel it before then.
An order you place before the market opens so it is ready when trading starts.

items.q: Can I change or cancel an order?
items.a: Yes. QuickTrade Pro lets you modify or cancel an order that has not been fully filled.
